example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনে এই সমস্যা একটা কাঁটা হয়ে দাঁড়িয়েছে।
আমি হলাম তার সুখের পথে কাঁটা।
example_sentences_in_english: This problem has become a thorn in his life.
I became a thorn in the path of his happiness.
note: Commonly used metaphor derived from the physical discomfort caused by thorns in rural or natural settings.
